name: Cryonic-Tempest
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a subterranean ocean, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
At the buried megastructure, the toolmarks are still half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
